title: 01. RAG Foundations: The Retrieve-Read Pipeline (Basic Flow)
summary: The Retrieve-Read pipeline is the fundamental execution pattern of RAG: given a user query, retrieve relevant documents, then read (generate) an answer conditioned on those documents.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: The Retrieve-Read pipeline is the fundamental execution pattern of RAG: given a user query, retrieve relevant documents, then read (generate) an answer conditioned on those documents. At its core, this pipeline has two stages operating in sequence: the **retriever** (typically an ANN search over a vector database) produces a set of context documents, and the **reader** (the LLM) synthesizes them into a coherent answer. Production implementations optimize this pipeline at every step — query preprocessing before retrieval, reranking between retrieval and reading, and structured prompting during reading. The pipeline can be synchronous (sequential) or parallelized (multiple retrieval sources merged before reading). Understanding the data transformations at each boundary (text → vector → text → tokens → answer) is essential for debugging failures.

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
RETRIEVE-READ PIPELINE — DATA FLOW
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Step 1: QUERY ENCODING
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
"What is the refund policy?"
              │
              ▼ text-embedding-3-large
    [0.12, -0.54, 0.89, ..., 0.33]  (3072 dims)

Step 2: ANN RETRIEVAL
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Query Vector ──▶  HNSW Index  ──▶  Top-5 Candidate Chunks
                 (Qdrant)
                                   Score  Chunk
                                   0.91   "Refunds within 30 days..."
                                   0.87   "Items must be unopened..."
                                   0.84   "Contact support@..."
                                   0.79   "Exclusions: digital downloads"
                                   0.73   "Processing time: 5-7 days"

Step 3: CONTEXT ASSEMBLY
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[Source 1: policy.pdf, p.3]
Refunds within 30 days of purchase...

[Source 2: policy.pdf, p.3]
Items must be unopened and in original packaging...

[Source 3: support.pdf, p.1]
Contact support@company.com for return labels...

Step 4: LLM GENERATION
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROMPT:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ You are a precise assistant. Use ONLY context to answer.│
│                                                          │
│ Context: [assembled chunks above]                        │
│                                                          │
│ Question: What is the refund policy?                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              │
              ▼ GPT-4o
"You can return items within 30 days [Source 1]. Items must
be unopened and in original packaging [Source 2]. Contact 
support@company.com for a return label [Source 3]."

BOUNDARY CHECKS:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
text ──▶ vector  : Same embedding model for query AND docs ✓
vector ──▶ chunks : Similarity threshold filters noise ✓
chunks ──▶ prompt : Format preserves source attribution ✓
prompt ──▶ answer : LLM constrained to context only ✓
```
